comment: The Lominsan Way's quest battle (59): the bomb (BNpcBase 1772, BNpcName 1385, layout 4295473; battalion 4), out 0.3-0.4 s after sequence 8: level 30, 897 HP. It never moved and did nothing but its blast (1133, round itself) 32.0 s after it came out, unless killed first (three of five runs), and fell 2 s after it: the director holds it and has it blow (content/questbattle/59.lua). From Bob's Chronofoil captures 44df02fc (2026-11-03, six runs, the last won) and c9145fdc (2026-11-03, one run, won), `questkit chronofoil --battle`; a level 34-35 player: the blast's damage to 1771 (2290, 2294) and the player (1826, the one run they stood by it). Hitbox not recorded.
